QuestInfo.name: Shields are Hard
QuestInfo.0: Ask #b#p3001008##k if he has any idea how to stop the monsters from attacking the supply route.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p3001008##k has a brilliant method for dealing with the monsters! Eliminate the #b#o2400109##k monsters and collect #b#t4000730##k items. Show the monsters who they're dealing with!
QuestInfo.2: You collected the #t4000730# items from the #b#o2400109##k monsters and brought them to #p3001008#. #p3001008# was super grateful and asked you to tell #p3001001# not to worry about the supplies anymore.

0.0: Angelic Buster, I got a good idea! You know those #b#o2400109##k troops? Those things are solid as can be. Maybe we can use those for our supply runners!\r\n#L0##bThey aren't THAT hard. I was breaking them in half with my eyes closed! #l\n#k
0.1: Yeah, but you're like... the strongest, coolest fighter ever! A bunch of monsters can't do what you can.\r\n#L0##bYeeah, I guess I'm pretty amazing!#l\n#k
0.2: Told ya! Even #p3001001# said that he was scared of Shieldbearers!\r\n#L0##bWell, he didn't mean... You know what? Yes. He's totally scared of Shieldbearers.#l\n#k
0.3: Hahaha! I knew it. This is a good plan. Can you go swipe some shields?\r\n#r#e(If you accept, you will automatically move to the relevant field.)\r\n

yes.0: You can still blow them up! Just don't blow them up too hard! I think #b100#k would be enough to supply our runners.

no.0: I do not know stealing. I only know exploding. How am I going to beat up a #b#o2400109##k without breaking its shields?

1.0: How did it go? I don't see any bits of shrapnel in your hair...

yes.0: Whoa, did you carry all those shields on your own?! Why didn't you ask me to come and help you out? I would. I would help you do anything you ever wanted me to help you do... Oh, I mean... c-can you tell #b#p3001001##k we're back up and running?

item.0: We'd need #b100 #t4000730##k items from the #b#o2400109##k troops to outfit all of our runners.
